- 7.50 mm pocket: I can't tell you how that one came out.

Send me the design again with submit_design, changed or unchanged, and I'll print it again from what you send.

I’ll resend it unchanged since there isn’t a confirmed fit result to adjust from. The hex pocket is **8.4 mm across flats**; **7.5 mm** is the gap between the snap-retaining tips. Please test hand insertion and upside-down retention on the coupon first.

{"note":"Unchanged geometry: 30 mm one-piece knob, 8.4 mm across-flats nut pocket and 7.5 mm gap between snap-retaining tips. Previous print feedback did not establish fit, so no dimensional correction has been made. Optional coupon tests the same retention features.","params":{"nut_af":{"value":8,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog","note":"ISO 4032 M5 across flats"},"nut_h":{"value":4.7,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"bolt_d":{"value":5,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"knob_d":{"value":30,"kind":"design","source":"asked","note":"Requested approximate outside diameter"},"height":{"value":10.4,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"floor":{"value":2.4,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"pocket_allowance":{"value":0.4,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Total across-flats clearance"},"bolt_allowance":{"value":0.6,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Diametral clearance"},"axial_play":{"value":0.4,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"latch_interference":{"value":0.5,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Tip gap = nut_af minus latch_interference, not hex pocket size"},"lip_land":{"value":0.3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"ramp_h":{"value":1,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"finger_width":{"value":4,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"finger_wall":{"value":1,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"slot_width":{"value":0.8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"slot_overlap":{"value":0.3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"root_z":{"value":1.2,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"finger_top":{"value":9,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"grip_count":{"value":12,"unit":"count","kind":"design","source":"design"},"grip_cut_d":{"value":3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_d":{"value":20,"kind":"design","source":"design"}},"parts":[{"id":"knob","role":"final","material":"PLA","code":"def build(p):
    import math
    af = p.nut_af+p.pocket_allowance
    h = p.height
    b = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.knob_d/2).extrude(h)
    for i in range(int(p.grip_count)):
        a = 2*math.pi*i/p.grip_count
        b = b.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').center(p.knob_d/2*math.cos(a),p.knob_d/2*math.sin(a)).circle(p.grip_cut_d/2).extrude(h))
    verts = [(af/math.sqrt(3)*math.cos(math.pi*i/3),af/math.sqrt(3)*math.sin(math.pi*i/3)) for i in range(6)]
    b = b.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.floor).polyline(verts).close().extrude(h))
    b = b.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bolt_allowance)/2).extrude(h))
    inner = af/2
    outer = inner+p.finger_wall
    w = p.finger_width
    s = p.slot_width
    zlip = p.floor+p.nut_h+p.axial_play
    for sign in (-1,1):
        b = b.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').box(w+2*s,s,h-p.root_z,centered=(True,True,False)).translate((0,sign*(outer+s/2),p.root_z)))
        y0 = inner-p.slot_overlap
        y1 = outer+s
        for side in (-1,1):
            b = b.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').box(s,y1-y0,h-p.root_z,centered=(True,True,False)).translate((side*(w/2+s/2),sign*(y0+y1)/2,p.root_z)))
        b = b.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').box(w,y1-y0,h-p.finger_top,centered=(True,True,False)).translate((0,sign*(y0+y1)/2,p.finger_top)))
        tip = (p.nut_af-p.latch_interference)/2
        profile = [(sign*inner,zlip),(sign*tip,zlip),(sign*tip,zlip+p.lip_land),(sign*inner,zlip+p.lip_land+p.ramp_h)]
        b = b.union(cq.Workplane('YZ').polyline(profile).close().extrude(w).translate((-w/2,0,0)))
    return b","print_orientation":"Flat underside on bed at z=0; nut opening upward. No supports.","use_orientation":"Nut enters top pocket. Bolt follows z axis. Solid underside faces clamped work."},{"id":"fit_coupon","role":"coupon","material":"PLA","code":"def build(p):
    import math
    af = p.nut_af+p.pocket_allowance
    h = p.height
    b = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.coupon_d/2).extrude(h)
    verts = [(af/math.sqrt(3)*math.cos(math.pi*i/3),af/math.sqrt(3)*math.sin(math.pi*i/3)) for i in range(6)]
    b = b.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.floor).polyline(verts).close().extrude(h))
    b = b.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bolt_allowance)/2).extrude(h))
    inner = af/2
    outer = inner+p.finger_wall
    w = p.finger_width
    s = p.slot_width
    zlip = p.floor+p.nut_h+p.axial_play
    for sign in (-1,1):
        b = b.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').box(w+2*s,s,h-p.root_z,centered=(True,True,False)).translate((0,sign*(outer+s/2),p.root_z)))
        y0 = inner-p.slot_overlap
        y1 = outer+s
        for side in (-1,1):
            b = b.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').box(s,y1-y0,h-p.root_z,centered=(True,True,False)).translate((side*(w/2+s/2),sign*(y0+y1)/2,p.root_z)))
        b = b.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').box(w,y1-y0,h-p.finger_top,centered=(True,True,False)).translate((0,sign*(y0+y1)/2,p.finger_top)))
        tip = (p.nut_af-p.latch_interference)/2
        profile = [(sign*inner,zlip),(sign*tip,zlip),(sign*tip,zlip+p.lip_land),(sign*inner,zlip+p.lip_land+p.ramp_h)]
        b = b.union(cq.Workplane('YZ').polyline(profile).close().extrude(w).translate((-w/2,0,0)))
    return b","print_orientation":"Flat underside on bed at z=0; opening upward. No supports.","use_orientation":"Test only; duplicates final nut pocket, shoulder, fingers and bolt passage."}],"hardware":[{"id":"nut","ref":"ISO 4032 M5","qty":1},{"id":"bolt","ref":"ISO 4762 M5x30","qty":1}],"joints":[{"id":"bolt_joint","fastener":"bolt","axis_origin":[0,0,0],"axis_dir":[0,0,1],"seats":[{"part":"knob","feature":"Central 5.6 mm through passage; illustrative bench-check bolt location","role":"clearance"}],"external":"Captured hardware nut: ISO 4032 M5 at z=2.4 to 7.1 mm. In service bolt head seats on external work."}],"criteria":[{"id":"hex_fit","part":"knob","feature":"8.4 mm across-flats hex pocket","relation":"contains","hardware":"nut","clearance_mm":0.4,"params":["nut_af","pocket_allowance"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"fit_coupon","description":"Nut presses fully home using fingers only."}},{"id":"retention","part":"knob","feature":"Two snap fingers with 7.5 mm opposed tip gap and 0.4 mm nominal axial play","relation":"engages","hardware":"nut","params":["nut_af","nut_h","latch_interference","axial_play","floor","finger_wall","finger_width"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"fit_coupon","description":"Both fingers spring back over nut. Nut stays captured when inverted and gently shaken without bolt. No cracks or permanent deformation."}},{"id":"stop","part":"knob","feature":"2.4 mm bottom shoulder around 5.6 mm passage","relation":"supports","hardware":"nut","params":["floor","bolt_d","bolt_allowance","nut_af"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"fit_coupon","description":"Nut rests on shoulder and cannot pass through bottom opening."}},{"id":"recess","part":"knob","feature":"Nut top nominally at z=7.1 mm below 10.4 mm rim","relation":"contains","hardware":"nut","params":["floor","nut_h","height"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"fit_coupon","description":"Nut is entirely below rim."}},{"id":"bolt_path","part":"knob","feature":"Central through passage","relation":"clears","hardware":"bolt","clearance_mm":0.6,"params":["bolt_d","bolt_allowance"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"fit_coupon","description":"Bolt threads through nut by hand and tip exits opposite face without binding on plastic."}}],"manual":[{"n":"1","text":"Print fit_coupon first: PLA, 0.2 mm layers, flat underside down, 4 walls, 5 top/bottom layers and 30% infill. Disable supports, including in slots. Use identical settings for knob. The hex pocket is 8.4 mm across flats; 7.5 mm describes only the opposed retaining-tip gap.","parts":["fit_coupon"],"tool":"3D printer"},{"n":"2","text":"Cool fully and remove stray strings. Align nut flats with pocket and push straight down with your thumb until both fingers spring back above it. Do not hammer or use bolt to force insertion. Nut must be entirely below rim.","parts":["fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"3","text":"Invert and gently shake over a tray without bolt. Nut must stay in and fingers must be intact and returned. Thread bolt through by hand to confirm its tip exits the other face. If latch force is excessive, reduce latch_interference from 0.5 to 0.3 mm and reprint coupon. If hex walls bind, increase pocket_allowance by 0.1 mm and retest. If retention fails, increase latch_interference by 0.1 mm and retest. Do not proceed with failed tests.","parts":["fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut","bolt"]},{"n":"4","text":"Print knob with validated parameters and identical settings. To recover test nut, remove bolt, gently spread coupon fingers with fingertips and push nut out from underneath with a fingertip. If it will not release by hand, sacrifice coupon or use another identical nut; do not pry against fingers intended for reuse.","parts":["knob","fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut"],"tool":"3D printer"},{"n":"5","text":"Press nut into knob as tested. Verify both latches return, nut sits fully inside and inversion retention passes. No glue or extra printed pieces are needed.","parts":["knob"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"6","text":"Turn knob onto M5 bolt by hand. Face solid underside toward clamped work so tightening loads the shoulder, not snap fingers. M5x30 is listed for fit checking; available projection must suit your application. Tighten only by hand without pliers or levers. Avoid heat and safety-critical use.","parts":["knob"],"hardware":["nut","bolt"]}]}
